newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy offers clients Internet, tv links.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy offers clients Internet, tv links.

text.p: KN Energy Inc. said on Monday it would offer its customers a bundle of information and communication services in addition to natural gas.
The company said in a statement it would provide satellite television access, long-distance telephone billing options and Internet access to its mainly-rural customer base.
It would also set up toll-free phone numbers for customers to order spare electric parts, summon electricians and talk to technicians about -- all to be paid for in one monthy bill.
KN Energy said it hoped to sell these so-called "Simple Choice" services to other regional utility companies.

In bringing these services to its rural customers, KN Energy has teamed up with satellite-entertainment company DISH Network, Metricom Inc. Ricochet wireless modem and Internet service, Frontier Corp HomeSaver Long Distance Service, MaxServ Inc. and DQE Weatherwise.
Services will include phone hotlines to order a choice of some 200 spare parts and to speak to technicians on anything from formatting a computer hard drive to installing pilot lights.
